note: FULL CONFIDENCE HEAD + POSE COPY, L2-SP 1e-3 ANCHORING EVERYTHING EXCEPT THE POSE PARAMETERS. The 8 pose tensors (block 0's linear_no_bias_d and linear_no_bias_d_wo_onehot plus three copies of each, 40,960 parameters) train FREE with no anchor; the other 246 head tensors go from FROZEN to trainable-but-priced at 1e-3 * ||W - W_shipped||^2. The exclusion is an unanchored regex, so it selects exactly the set dntxmn trained, and the launch log must print 8 excluded / 246 anchored or the arm is not what it claims. WHY: every capacity increase so far went into the generalisation gap. The unconstrained full head (wpg274, 50 ep) ended with val PAE 3.0990 against 2.7463 at epoch 1 while train fell to 1.7854, and its best epoch of 50 was still below shipped on paired DockQ (-0.0020 +- 0.0292 on val10's 18 interfaces). share and copy kept val falling but converted train gains to val at about half rate, and copy's gap was already wider than share's by +0.0067 +- 0.0017 over 12 matched epochs. So the hypothesis is not less capacity but capacity ONLY WHERE IT IS NEW: no reason to want the 246 pretrained tensors far from shipped, every reason to want the pose injection free. LAMBDA IS NOT DERIVED -- 1e-3 is the user's choice (lowered from 1e-2 before launch, because 1e-2 would price wpg274's measured drift of 3,801 at 38.0 against a loss near 2.6 and likely pin the 246 tensors; 1e-3 prices it at 3.8) and l2sp_lambda.py's transfer formula is deliberately not used, since on wpg274 it produced a penalty of 0.0380 against a loss near 2.0 by sizing lambda for an assumed drift 18x larger than what occurred. Read the measured ||W-W0||^2 and penalty printed each epoch against train and val PAE. ONE VARIABLE AGAINST dntxmn: same fold, selection, skip list, crop, lr, seeds, accum, nsample, valfull, 20 epochs, pose-copy injection; the trainable restriction removed and the anchor added. CONTROL: dntxmn through epoch 14 ran paired dDockQ +0.0016 mean on valfull's 92 interfaces, rho 0.2478 vs shipped 0.2218, val PAE bottoming at 2.7580 at epoch 13. TEN-EPOCH MINIMUM does not apply -- the user retracted it. VAL10 AND VALFULL ARE NOT COMPARABLE.
